title: Cancellation and Return Premium Provisions, Larkspur Personal Umbrella Policy
content:
## Section 1. Cancellation by the named insured

1.1 The named insured cancels the Larkspur Personal Umbrella Policy only by a signed request, effective no earlier than the date it is received.

1.2 The cancellation is processed only on a request the named insured has signed. The signed request is the named insured's own act; a request not signed by the named insured does not cancel the umbrella.

1.3 The named insured may cancel an umbrella that is bound, before it takes effect, or an umbrella in force, midterm.

## Section 2. Return of unearned premium

2.1 Unearned premium on a named-insured cancellation is pro rata or short rate according to the tier's return basis, keeping the tier's short-rate share of the pro-rata unearned premium on a short-rate cancellation, and never keeping less than the tier's minimum earned premium.

2.2 A cancellation before the effective date is flat: the credit is the term premium in full, nothing having been earned.

2.3 A carrier cancellation credits pro rata in full.

## Section 3. Refund of a credit balance

3.1 A credit balance of at least the tier's refund minimum is refunded to the named insured by the method of the last payment.

A credit balance is a premium balance below zero, that is an amount the company owes the named insured.

## Credit basis at a glance

| Who cancels, and when | Credit basis | What the company keeps |
|---|---|---|
| Named insured, before the effective date | Flat | Nothing |
| Named insured, on or after the effective date, tier on the short-rate basis | Short rate | The short-rate share of the pro-rata unearned premium, and never less than the minimum earned premium |
| Named insured, on or after the effective date, tier on the pro-rata basis | Pro rata | The pro-rata earned premium, and never less than the minimum earned premium |
| The company | Pro rata in full | The earned premium only |

## Worked credits (hypothetical inputs)

**Short rate.** Hypothetical term premium $268.00 on a tier with a short-rate share of 10 percent and a minimum earned premium of $50.00; the pro-rata unearned premium at the cancellation date is $134.00. The company keeps 10 percent of $134.00, which is $13.40, so the credit is $134.00 less $13.40, which is $120.60. The premium kept is $147.40, not below $50.00.

**Minimum earned premium.** Same hypothetical tier and premium, with a pro-rata unearned premium of $250.00. The short-rate credit would be $225.00, leaving $43.00 kept, which is below $50.00. The company keeps $50.00, so the credit is $268.00 less $50.00, which is $218.00.

**Pro rata.** Hypothetical term premium $507.00 on a pro-rata tier with a minimum earned premium of $50.00, cancelled at the midpoint with a pro-rata unearned premium of $253.50. The credit is $253.50; the $253.50 kept is not below $50.00.

**Refund.** A hypothetical credit balance of $12.40 on a tier with a $5.00 refund minimum is refunded to the named insured by the same method as the last payment. A credit balance of $3.00 is below the refund minimum and is not refunded.
